entities.summary: Parviz Meshkatian (b. 1955-05-15, Nishapur) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Nishapur and Iran. Known in the fields of iran, composers & musicians, asia.
